name: POST /api/auth/sso/signup/preview - details for Google/Microsoft sign-up
description: Public: the one-time code from /signup/sso#code=... (issued by the SSO callback when a provider-verified email has no account; 15 minutes, single use) is the credential. Returns provider, the verified email and the name from the ID token so the page can pre-fill it. Does not use up the code. Covers: a user can sign in (and sign up) with Google or Microsoft SSO.
happyPathNote: A valid code is only minted by a real provider round trip; verified with a local OIDC mock (preview 200, then sign-up 201, reuse 401).
